title: Letter grades
prompt: letter_grade(score) should return "A" for 90 and above, "B" for 80-89, "C" for 70-79 and "F" otherwise. Students who score exactly 90 are getting a B. Fix it.
hints: The failing cases are all exactly on a boundary: 90, 80 and 70.
Does '>' include the number itself? Compare 90 > 90 with 90 >= 90.
Change each '>' to '>=' so the boundary score falls into the higher grade.
explanation: Each threshold used '>' instead of '>=', so boundary scores (90, 80, 70) fell into the grade below.
